## What and why

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit --signoff`)
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits (see `.gitmessage`)
- [ ] Tests cover the change (a failing test first for a behaviour change)
- [ ] `./gradlew build` passes locally
- [ ] Docs, module README and CHANGELOG updated where behaviour changed
